name: Agentlas-OS
tagline_zh: 别让每个AI单打独斗。把专家Agent收进中枢，每项任务临时拉一个指挥——本地跑，任意模型，任务结束指挥即散。
tagline_en: Stop letting AI agents work solo. Keep specialists in a hub, spin a temp orchestrator per task—local-first, any.
desc_en: Agent OS: keep specialist agents in a hub, spin up a temporary orchestrator per task. Local-first, works with any model.
why_zh: 同类让你固定编排，它却按任务现造指挥，用完即弃，省资源且不锁死模型。
why_en: Unlike fixed pipelines, it spawns a per-task orchestrator that dies after—lightweight, model-agnostic, and truly local.
